subject: Convergence check-in: environment commissioning (API keys, org setup, IP allowlist, VPC peering)
messages:
From: Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.ai>
To: Sarah Lim <sarah@fluxhealth.ai>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 09 Dec 2026 09:18:00 -0800
Subject: Convergence check-in: environment commissioning (api keys / org / allowlist / peering)

Hi Sarah,

Quick check-in as we converge on the MAP milestones for the POC environment. Below are the live items we need to close to get the sandbox running end-to-end: brief, actionable items so teams can coordinate.

Scope items we want confirmed in this week
- Org admin onboarding: add the following admin accounts on your org console so we can create scoped API keys: marissa_cole@redwood.ai, ben_carter@redwood.ai.
- API keys: we will generate two keys for the POC: one limited-scope key for evaluation traffic and one admin key for integration work. Please confirm whether keys need a fixed expiration or if short-lived tokens via your vault are required.
- IP allowlist: we need the CIDR blocks you will allow for peered traffic. See the attached vpc_peering_request template for how we consume this.
- VPC peering: proposed peering window Dec 14-15 (non-production hours). We will request peering from our infra side once you confirm the acceptor CIDR and a named contact for network ops.

Proposed timeline (MAP milestones):
- Dec 9: Confirm admin emails, IP ranges, and peering contact (today)
- Dec 11: Redwood provides API keys and peering request ticket to your ops contact
- Dec 14-15: VPC peering window and preliminary connectivity smoke tests
- Dec 16-18: Acceptance testing (latency and token flow) and sign-off

Attached: MAP_FluxHealth_v1.3.pdf (MAP draft, includes acceptance criteria), vpc_peering_request_fluxhealth.csv (peering template).

If anything here is misaligned with your procurement/compliance constraints, flag it and we will adjust. Short ask: can you confirm admin emails and provide an ops contact + preferred peering date by end of day?

Thanks,
Priyom Das
Senior Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
pri...@redwood.ai

Attachment stubs:
- MAP_FluxHealth_v1.3.pdf (PDF, 42KB)
- vpc_peering_request_fluxhealth.csv (CSV, 4KB)

From: Sarah Lim <sarah@fluxhealth.ai>
To: Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.ai>
Cc: FluxHealth ops <ops@fluxhealth.ai>
Date: Tue, 09 Dec 2026 10:02:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Convergence check-in: environment commissioning (api keys / org setup / allowlist / peering)

Priyom,

Thanks — this is helpful. Quick answers below:
- Admin onboarding: we can add marissa_cole@redwood.ai and ben_carter@redwood.ai as org admins. Our identity team requires SSO for admin roles; we will confirm the SSO provider details by EOD.
- IP allowlist: please add the following outbound blocks to your template: 52.33.120.0/22, 34.120.0.0/16. We will accept inbound peering from 10.40.0.0/16 on our side.
- VPC peering contact: Tom Heil (tom.heil@fluxhealth.ai) will own peering coordination. He is copied on ops@fluxhealth.ai for this thread.
- Peering window: Dec 14 morning is best for us; we can do Dec 14 09:00-12:00 PST for handshake + initial routing.

We reviewed the MAP PDF at a high level and like the acceptance tests. One compliance note: we need to see a data retention statement for logs forwarded during the POC — can you attach a short snippet?

Tom will follow up with precise CIDR confirmation and a ticket in our network queue.

Best,
Sarah Lim
Director of Platform, FluxHealth

On Tue, Dec 9, 2026 at 09:18 Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.ai> wrote:
> Quick check-in as we converge on the MAP milestones for the POC environment...

Attachment referenced: vpc_peering_request_fluxhealth.csv (template provided).

From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
To: Tom Heil <tom.heil@fluxhealth.ai>, Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.ai>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 10 Dec 2026 08:30:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Convergence check-in: environment commissioning (api keys / org setup / allowlist / peering)

Tom / team,

Quick technical notes from infra before peering:
- API key scopes: for evaluation traffic we recommend an "eval-only" scope that disables model management and account-level quotas. We will provide a JSON policy bundle when we create the keys.
- Service account: if you prefer, create a FluxHealth service account for programmatic access and we will issue a key pair tied to that identity. That keeps billing scoped and makes rotation easier.
- Short-lived tokens: if your security team requires short-lived tokens from your vault, we can support token-exchange flows; let us know the vault vendor (HashiCorp Vault, AWS Secrets Manager).
- Peering checklist: please ensure your route table allows the 10.40.0.0/16 prefix and that you have a permissioned NACL for the peering tunnel.

I can drive the key creation once SSO admin confirmation arrives. Priyom, Marissa: can we plan a 30-minute runbook walkthrough on Dec 12 to cover token exchange and acceptance tests?

Thanks,
Ben Carter
Solutions Architect, Redwood Inference

From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
To: Sarah Lim <sarah@fluxhealth.ai>, Tom Heil <tom.heil@fluxhealth.ai>
Cc: Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 10 Dec 2026 15:45:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Convergence check-in: environment commissioning (api keys / org setup / allowlist / peering)

Sarah / Tom,

Thanks for the quick responses and the CIDR details — that schedule works. Confirming next steps and acceptance checklist so everyone has a single source of truth:

1) Admin & SSO
- FluxHealth to add marissa_cole@redwood.ai and ben_carter@redwood.ai as org admins and confirm SSO provider by Dec 9 EOD (noted).
2) API keys & service account
- Redwood will create two keys after SSO confirmation: eval-only key (scoped) and integration key (service-account tied). Keys will be sent over a secure channel and will appear in the MAP attachments.
3) Network & peering
- FluxHealth accepts inbound 10.40.0.0/16; Redwood will request peering from 10.50.0.0/16.
- Peering window: Dec 14 09:00-12:00 PST. Tom to confirm ticket and route table update by Dec 11.
4) Acceptance testing (owners)
- Redwood (Ben): latency and request/response correctness tests; token rotation verification.
- FluxHealth (Tom / Ops): route validation, connectivity, and firewall behavior under sample load.
- Joint: run the smoke test harness on Dec 15; results published to the shared Drive link.
5) Sign-off
- Target sign-off by Dec 18 if tests pass.

Marissa will run the Dec 12 runbook walkthrough with Ben and Priyom; Tom, please confirm if Dec 12 10:00 PST works for you.

If that looks good I'll update the MAP PDF and push version 1.4 to the Drive link and mark the vpc_peering_request template as filled.

Cheers,
Marissa Cole
Customer Success Manager, Redwood Inference
marissa_cole@redwood.ai

--
Attachment stubs referenced: MAP_FluxHealth_v1.3.pdf -> will update to v1.4 on confirmation.
